components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary operational action button using Mineral Slate / Nord Frost Blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--primary, 212 32% 42%)); background: hsl(var(--primary, 212 32% 42%)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground, 40 38% 98%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 212 32% 50%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary framed action with WCAG 3:1 accessible field border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--field-border, 30 12% 50%)); background: hsl(var(--card, 40 38% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 30 16% 15%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: hsl(var(--muted, 38 18% 90%)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 212 32% 50%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: High-consequence destructive action gated by confirmation dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--destructive, 0 34% 48%)); background: hsl(var(--destructive, 0 34% 48%)); color: #ffffff; font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 212 32% 50%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input Field
components.description: Accessible text field with 3:1 border and 4.5:1 placeholder contrast.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Fran — 21-15-9" value="" aria-label="Workout title" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--field-border, 30 12% 50%)); background: hsl(var(--card, 40 38% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 30 16% 15%)); font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); font-size: 14px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsl(var(--field-placeholder, 30 12% 42%)); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(var(--ring, 212 32% 50%)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Whiteboard Metric Pill
components.description: Deterministic semantic metric fragment pill for parsed workout tokens.
components.html: Thrusters21 Reps@95lb
components.css: .ds-metric-row { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-metric-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: var(--font-mono, ui-monospace, monospace); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-effort { color: hsl(var(--metric-effort, 140 32% 36%)); background: hsl(var(--metric-effort, 140 32% 36%) / 0.14); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--metric-effort, 140 32% 36%) / 0.4); } .ds-metric-rep { color: hsl(var(--metric-rep, 30 48% 38%)); background: hsl(var(--metric-rep, 30 48% 38%) / 0.14); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--metric-rep, 30 48% 38%) / 0.4); } .ds-metric-resistance { color: hsl(var(--metric-resistance, 0 36% 43%)); background: hsl(var(--metric-resistance, 0 36% 43%) / 0.14); border: 1px solid hsl(var(--metric-resistance, 0 36% 43%) / 0.4); }

components.name: Workout Card Surface
components.description: Flat, tonally lifted card container with 1px hairline border.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border, 36 14% 76%)); background: hsl(var(--card, 40 38% 98%)); color: hsl(var(--foreground, 30 16% 15%)); padding: 16px 20px; font-family: var(--font-sans, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; } .ds-card-meta { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 13px; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground, 30 13% 37%)); }

narrative.overview:
WOD Wiki is an operational training workspace that bridges two demanding environments: calm, focused plain-text authoring and WQL analysis at a desk, and high-legibility, sweaty-hand-proof live workout execution on a phone or gym-wall TV. The visual system draws from geological survey palettes and technical field notebooks—warm, paper-like cream surfaces in light mode (Mineral) and low-glare polar night surfaces in dark mode (Arctic Frost)—so color is reserved for meaning rather than decoration.

Every parsed workout fragment (Time, Rep, Effort, Rounds, Distance, Resistance, Action, Rest, Equipment) maps deterministically to one of nine calibrated semantic metric hues. Surfaces stay quiet and flat by default; interaction state, live clock polarity, and metric origin carry the visual signal. All design tokens live in a single canonical stylesheet (packages/ui/src/styles.css) consumed identically by Playground, Storybook, and the @bitcobblers/wod-wiki-ui package.
keyCharacteristics: Dual calibrated palettes: warm geological Mineral (light) and Nord-inspired Arctic Frost (dark), flipped exclusively via <html class="dark">
Nine WCAG AA-calibrated Whiteboard Language metric tokens shared across CodeMirror syntax, inline previews, live timers, and WQL analytics
Tactile, touch-safe @ui-sdk/react primitives (40px default, 44px icon/mobile targets) with browser top-layer overlays
Tabular monospace numerals (tabular-nums) for all timers, splits, loads, and telemetry tables
Three container-driven timer tiers (Minimal phone, General 16:9 TV, Detail desktop workbench) backed by one SessionClockProjection

rules.name: The Root-Host Dark Mode Rule
rules.body: The .dark class lives strictly on <html> (document.documentElement), never on an inner wrapper <div>. Because @theme inline emits hsl(var(--token)) per element, root toggling guarantees portals, top-layer dialogs, and Storybook canvases flip atomically.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Only Rule
rules.body: Never hardcode hex values or raw Tailwind grays (bg-slate-900, text-zinc-400, rgba(128,128,128,...)) in components or stylesheets. Every surface, text, border, and metric badge resolves through semantic CSS custom properties.

rules.name: The Tabular Numerals Rule
rules.body: Every live clock, split time, rep count, load value, and numeric table column must apply tabular-nums so digits never jitter horizontally during workout execution.

rules.name: The 16px Mobile Input Floor
rules.body: On viewports below 1024px, CodeMirror editors and text inputs render at a minimum 16px font size to prevent iOS Safari auto-zoom mid-workout.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Rest-state containers use tonal contrast and 1px borders—never combine heavy drop shadows with borders on standard cards.

dos: Do toggle dark mode strictly on <html> (document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark')) so @theme inline tokens and top-layer overlays stay synchronized.
Do use @bitcobblers/wod-wiki-ui/primitives for all buttons, fields, selects, switches, tabs, dialogs, drawers, popovers, menus, and toasts.
Do apply tabular-nums to all clocks, durations, rep counts, weights, and analytics KPIs.
Do keep packages/ui state-free and storage-agnostic (inject QueryExecutor and callbacks via props).
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (and [data-reduced-motion="true"] in Storybook) for all non-essential animations.
donts: Don't place .dark on an inner wrapper <div>—it breaks top-layer portals and @theme inline inheritance.
Don't hardcode raw Tailwind grays (bg-slate-900, text-zinc-400), hex colors, or font-family: "Inter" in components or app CSS.
Don't invent ad-hoc badge colors for workout fragments—always map through the 9 --metric-* semantic tokens.
Don't drop interactive touch targets below 44x44px on mobile or active workout timer surfaces.
Don't render modal dialogs for tasks that can be handled inline or via progressive disclosure.
